scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to smooth complex complete-intersection threefolds in ordinary projective space.
Only the general-type range S > c + 4 is included.
Codimension and the sum of defining degrees are fixed; no cross-codimension comparison is asserted.
A recent weighted-complete-intersection preprint on geometric-genus lower bounds was only available through its abstract, leaving a residual literature-comparison risk.
title: Fixed-canonical majorization law for geometric genus of complete-intersection threefolds
